about: Our own one-line descriptions for the catalog's look-alike visit types (decision 79). The given catalog has none: 'Skin Cancer Screening' and 'Full Body Skin Exam' have identical data. The agent may describe a visit type only with these lines, so it never makes a difference up. In each group, 'usual' is the visit booked when the caller says they don't mind which. These are our assumptions, not clinic policy; a real catalog would carry its own descriptions.

visit_types.appt_027: A check of particular moles or spots you're worried about.
visit_types.appt_028: A head-to-toe check of all your skin, moles and spots included.
visit_types.appt_026: A first visit with a dermatologist about a skin problem.

visit_types.appt_000: A longer first visit to go through your health history and any concerns.
visit_types.appt_001: A standard first visit to get to know a doctor.

visit_types.appt_004: An in-person check after an earlier visit.
visit_types.appt_005: A follow-up conversation about results or a treatment plan.
visit_types.appt_006: A follow-up by video or phone instead of in person.

visit_types.appt_002: A yearly check-up with a family doctor.
visit_types.appt_003: A yearly visit with an internal medicine doctor to review your health and prevention plan.

visit_types.appt_007: For a new illness that isn't an emergency, like a cold or an infection.
visit_types.appt_008: For something that needs seeing today but isn't an emergency.

visit_types.appt_045: A standard check of your vision.
visit_types.appt_046: A longer, fuller check of your vision and eye health.

visit_types.appt_018: The check-up a school asks for.
visit_types.appt_019: The check-up needed before playing a sport.

visit_types.appt_072: A blood sample for tests your doctor has ordered.
visit_types.appt_073: A blood test taken after not eating beforehand; your doctor tells you for how long.

visit_types.appt_075: A check-up of your teeth and gums.
visit_types.appt_076: A longer first check-up for new dental patients.
visit_types.appt_074: A professional cleaning of your teeth.
